Its retirement left a noticeable gap in the company's catalog, and the new synth in Komplete 26 is positioned, at least in part, as a way to address demand from users who have been searching for a contemporary equivalent to that distinctive sound.

Komplete 26 also pushes further into experimental territory on the acoustic side. Rather than focusing solely on faithful recreations of grand pianos, the bundle includes piano instruments built around prepared-piano techniques, physical modifications, and processed tones intended for use as sound design source material. The approach reflects a broader trend toward hybrid scoring, where composers blend traditional acoustic instruments with electronic textures and abstract sonic elements, and it suggests Native Instruments is targeting media composers as much as conventional songwriters.

These new instruments slot into an ecosystem that continues to revolve around staples such as Kontakt, the company's widely used sampler platform, and Massive, the synthesizer that became a defining sound of electronic music in the 2010s. Komplete has long served as an umbrella product that ties these tools together with a deep library of effects, sampled instruments, and synthesis engines, and the 26th edition extends that model rather than overhauling it.

The release arrives in an increasingly competitive software instruments market. Companies such as Arturia and u-he have steadily released distinctive synthesizers that have eaten into territory Native Instruments once dominated, while subscription-based plugin services from rivals including Universal Audio and Output have changed how many producers acquire and rotate through tools. Against that backdrop, Komplete's traditional perpetual-license bundle model remains something of an industry benchmark, and updates like this one are important for maintaining its perceived value relative to the growing menu of monthly options.

The broader corporate context is also relevant. Native Instruments merged with audio software maker iZotope in 2022 and was subsequently brought under the Soundwide group, which also includes Plugin Alliance and Brainworx. Since then, the combined company has been gradually reorganizing its product lineup, sunsetting older instruments such as Absynth while consolidating development around platforms it considers strategically central. Komplete 26 may therefore be read as part of that ongoing rationalization, replacing legacy tools with new ones designed to fit a more unified product strategy.

For existing Komplete users, the practical question will be whether the new synth genuinely captures what made Absynth feel irreplaceable, or whether it simply gestures in that direction. Native Instruments has not described the new instrument as a direct successor, and details on its synthesis architecture remain limited at launch, so judgments about how closely it approximates Absynth's evolving, atmospheric character will likely depend on hands-on impressions in the weeks ahead.

Even so, the combination of a sound-design-focused synth, experimental piano instruments, and continued investment in core tools like Kontakt and Massive suggests Native Instruments is trying to reposition Komplete as something more than a comprehensive starter pack. The bundle increasingly looks aimed at composers and producers seeking distinctive, character-driven sounds rather than utilitarian basics, a shift that reflects where much of the high end of the plugin market has moved.

entries.title: The best beauty tech you can still grab in time for Mother’s Day
entries.titleJa: 母の日に間に合うおすすめ美容テックギフト特集
entries.titleEn: The best beauty tech you can still grab in time for Mother’s Day
entries.summaryJa: The Vergeが母の日に向けた美容テック製品の選りすぐりを紹介。LED美顔マスクやヘアドライヤー、電動歯ブラシなど、配送が間に合うガジェットを厳選し、価格帯や機能別に推奨アイテムをまとめた。
entries.summaryEn: The Verge rounds up beauty tech gift ideas that can still arrive in time for Mother's Day, spanning LED face masks, hair tools, electric toothbrushes and other wellness gadgets across various price points.

image.alt: The best beauty tech you can still grab in time for Mother’s Day

entries.bodyJa:
米メディアThe Vergeが、母の日ギフトとしておすすめの美容テック製品をまとめたガイドを公開した。配送が間に合うタイミングを考慮し、ガジェット好きな読者層に向けて選定された製品が並ぶ。

紹介されているのは、近年急成長を遂げているLED美顔マスクをはじめ、高機能ヘアドライヤーやヘアスタイラー、電動歯ブラシ、フェイシャルクレンジングデバイスなど多岐にわたるカテゴリ。価格帯も幅広く、手頃なものからハイエンドまでカバーしている。

美容テック市場は近年、Dyson、Shark、Therabodyといった家電・ウェルネス企業の参入により競争が激化している。特にLEDマスクはCurrentBody、Omnilux、Shark CryoGlowなどが牽引し、皮膚科領域で用いられる赤色光・近赤外線療法を家庭向けに転用したデバイスとして注目を集める。臨床的なエビデンスは製品ごとにばらつきがあるとされ、購入前には研究データの確認が推奨されると見られる。

ヘアケア分野ではDyson AirwrapやSupersonicが市場を再定義した一方、SharkのFlexStyleなどがより手頃な代替として人気を集めている。電動歯ブラシではOral-BやPhilips Sonicareが定番だが、近年はアプリ連携やAIによる磨き残し検出機能を備えたモデルも増えている。

ギフト商戦としての母の日は、米国小売業界において重要な売上機会の一つで、National Retail Federationの調査では毎年数十億ドル規模の支出が見込まれている。テック系メディアが美容ガジェットを取り上げる背景には、こうしたカテゴリがウェアラブルやスマートホームに次ぐ家電トレンドとして定着しつつある状況があると考えられる。
entries.bodyEn:
The Verge has published a curated gift guide highlighting beauty tech products that shoppers can still order in time for Mother's Day delivery. The selection targets gadget-savvy readers looking for last-minute presents that blend wellness with consumer electronics.

The lineup spans several fast-growing categories, including LED face masks, premium hair dryers and stylers, electric toothbrushes, and facial cleansing devices. The guide covers a wide price spectrum, with options ranging from affordable everyday tools to high-end devices that have become aspirational gifts in their own right.

The beauty tech category has expanded rapidly over the past few years, drawing in major appliance and wellness brands such as Dyson, Shark, and Therabody. LED masks in particular have surged in popularity, with companies like CurrentBody, Omnilux, and Shark's CryoGlow translating clinical red-light and near-infrared therapies into consumer-friendly form factors. Clinical evidence varies considerably between products, however, and shoppers may want to scrutinize the underlying studies before committing to higher-priced devices.

In hair care, Dyson's Airwrap and Supersonic redefined what consumers expect from a dryer or styler, prompting competitors like Shark to release more affordable alternatives such as the FlexStyle. Electric toothbrushes remain dominated by Oral-B and Philips Sonicare, though newer models increasingly bundle app connectivity, pressure sensors, and AI-driven coaching that flags missed spots during brushing.

Mother's Day is one of the most significant retail moments on the U.S. calendar, with the National Retail Federation regularly projecting multi-billion-dollar spending each year. Tech publications increasingly devote coverage to beauty gadgets around the holiday, reflecting how the category has matured into a mainstream consumer electronics segment alongside wearables and smart home devices.

The broader trend suggests that beauty tech is no longer a niche carve-out but a recognized pillar of the gadget industry. As more legacy electronics brands invest in skincare and grooming hardware, and as direct-to-consumer beauty startups add increasingly sophisticated sensors and software, gift guides like The Verge's are likely to become a recurring fixture during major holiday shopping windows.

entries.title: Power Platformフル活用で意思決定支援
entries.titleJa: Power PlatformとCopilotで意思決定を支援する業務改善の実践例
entries.summaryJa: Microsoft Power Platformを全面的に活用し、データ収集から可視化、Copilotによる対話的分析までを統合して意思決定を支援する取り組みを紹介。Power Apps、Power Automate、Power BI、Copilot Studioを組み合わせた構成により、現場の業務効率化と経営判断の迅速化を狙う。
entries.summaryEn: A practical case for leveraging Microsoft Power Platform end-to-end—combining Power Apps, Automate, BI, and Copilot Studio—to streamline data collection, visualization, and conversational analytics that support faster and better business decisions.

image.alt: Power Platformフル活用で意思決定支援

entries.bodyJa:
Microsoftが提供するPower Platformを業務全体に浸透させ、現場のデータ収集から経営層の意思決定支援までを一気通貫で担う取り組みが紹介されている。ローコード基盤とCopilotの組み合わせにより、専門エンジニアに頼らずとも継続的な業務改善が可能になりつつある点が注目される。

中核となるのは、Power Appsで構築したフロントエンドアプリによる入力業務の標準化、Power Automateを介したワークフロー自動化、そしてDataverseやSharePointへの蓄積データをPower BIで可視化する流れである。これにより、紙やExcelに散在していた情報が構造化され、ダッシュボード上で常に最新の状況を把握できる体制が整う。

さらにCopilot StudioやPower BIに統合されたCopilotを活用することで、自然言語による問い合わせから集計・分析結果を即座に得られる。これは経営会議や現場マネージャーの判断スピードを高める上で重要であり、従来BI担当者に依頼していたアドホック集計を利用者自身が完結できる可能性がある。

背景として、Microsoftは近年Copilotブランドを横断的に展開しており、Microsoft 365、Dynamics 365、Power Platformの各製品にAIアシスタントを組み込んでいる。GoogleのAppSheetやAWSのHoneycode（提供終了）など他社もローコード市場に参入してきたが、Office 365との統合性とCopilotによる生成AI連携でPower Platformが優位を保っているとみられる。一方で、ガバナンスや市民開発者の管理、ライセンスコストといった課題も依然として残っており、活用拡大には組織的な体制整備が不可欠だろう。
entries.bodyEn:
This article describes a practical effort to deploy Microsoft Power Platform across an organization, covering everything from frontline data entry to executive decision support. By combining low-code tooling with Copilot, the goal is to enable continuous business improvement without depending heavily on specialized engineers.

At the core of the approach is a layered architecture: Power Apps standardizes data entry through purpose-built front-end applications; Power Automate handles workflow automation and integrations between systems; and data accumulated in Dataverse or SharePoint is then surfaced through Power BI dashboards. The result is that information once scattered across paper forms and spreadsheets becomes structured and continuously visible, giving stakeholders a real-time view of operations.

Layered on top of this is Copilot, both inside Power BI and via Copilot Studio. Users can ask natural-language questions and receive aggregated insights or analytical responses on demand. For executives in steering meetings or middle managers reviewing KPIs, this can shorten the loop from question to answer dramatically. Tasks that previously required a BI specialist to write queries or build a custom report can increasingly be handled by the end user themselves, which may meaningfully shift how analytics work is distributed within an organization.

The broader context is that Microsoft has been aggressively extending its Copilot brand across Microsoft 365, Dynamics 365, and Power Platform, positioning generative AI as a default layer over its productivity stack. Competitors such as Google's AppSheet have pursued similar low-code strategies, while AWS retired Honeycode, signaling that integration with a broader productivity ecosystem matters more than the low-code engine alone. Power Platform appears to retain an edge thanks to its tight coupling with Office 365, Teams, and Azure identity, augmented by Copilot's conversational interface.

That said, scaling such a platform is not purely a technical exercise. Governance of citizen developers, environment and data loss prevention policies, premium connector licensing, and lifecycle management of community-built apps remain real challenges. Organizations that succeed tend to pair enthusiastic business users with a center-of-excellence team that defines guardrails. When that balance is struck, the combination of Power Platform and Copilot can plausibly evolve from a productivity tool into genuine decision-support infrastructure, though the pace and depth of that transformation will likely vary significantly by industry and organizational maturity.

entries.title: FDA vaccine studies censored by Trump admin after finding benefits of shots
entries.titleJa: トランプ政権、ワクチン有益性示すFDA研究を検閲
entries.titleEn: FDA vaccine studies censored by Trump admin after finding benefits of shots
entries.summaryJa: トランプ政権がFDAによるワクチン関連研究を検閲したと報じられた。研究結果が反ワクチン派のRFK Jr.保健長官の主張と矛盾し、ワクチンの有益性を示していたためとされる。科学的独立性への懸念が強まっている。
entries.summaryEn: The Trump administration reportedly censored FDA vaccine studies because their findings contradicted the anti-vaccine views of HHS Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. and demonstrated clear benefits of vaccination, raising fresh concerns about scientific independence at federal health agencies.

image.alt: FDA vaccine studies censored by Trump admin after finding benefits of shots

entries.bodyJa:
米食品医薬品局(FDA)が実施したワクチン関連研究が、トランプ政権下で公表を阻まれたとする報道が浮上した。研究結果がワクチンの有益性を示し、反ワクチン的立場で知られるロバート・F・ケネディ・ジュニア(RFK Jr.)保健福祉長官の見解と矛盾していたことが理由とされる。

Ars Technicaの報道によれば、検閲対象となった研究はワクチン接種による健康上の便益を裏付ける内容を含んでいた。FDAはこれまで独立した科学機関として、データに基づく評価を公表してきたが、政権の政治的方向性と整合しない結果が抑制された形となる。これは過去にも報じられた同種の検閲事例に続くものであり、保健行政における科学の独立性に対する懸念が一段と強まっている。

RFK Jr.は長年ワクチン安全性に懐疑的な立場を取ってきた人物で、保健福祉省(HHS)長官就任後、ワクチン諮問委員会(ACIP)の委員入れ替えや推奨スケジュールの見直しなど、複数の政策変更を進めてきた。FDA、CDC、NIHといった連邦保健機関の科学者からは、研究発表の自由や査読プロセスへの政治介入に対する内部告発や辞任が相次いでいると報じられている。

背景として、米国では麻疹のアウトブレイクが各地で再燃しており、公衆衛生コミュニティはワクチン接種率低下への警鐘を鳴らしてきた。科学的根拠に基づく情報発信が政治的に制限される場合、医療従事者や保護者の意思決定に影響し、ワクチン忌避がさらに進む可能性がある。今回の検閲報道は、米連邦政府の科学コミュニケーションの信頼性に長期的な影響を与える可能性があると見られる。
entries.bodyEn:
Reports have emerged that the Trump administration suppressed publication of vaccine-related studies conducted by the U.S. Food and Drug Administration after the research demonstrated clear benefits of vaccination — findings that conflicted with the long-held anti-vaccine positions of Health and Human Services Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr.

According to Ars Technica, the censored studies contained data supporting the protective health benefits of immunization. The FDA has historically operated as a science-driven agency that publishes evaluations grounded in clinical and epidemiological data, but the reported intervention suggests that results inconsistent with the administration's political stance are being withheld from public view. This follows earlier reports of similar suppression at federal health agencies, intensifying concerns about the erosion of scientific independence in U.S. public health.

RFK Jr., a longtime skeptic of vaccine safety, has used his position atop HHS to drive several controversial policy shifts. These include reshuffling the membership of the Advisory Committee on Immunization Practices (ACIP), revisiting recommended childhood immunization schedules, and altering messaging around mRNA platforms. Scientists at the FDA, CDC, and NIH have reportedly responded with internal dissent, whistleblower disclosures, and in some cases resignations, citing political interference in peer review and publication.

The broader context makes the censorship reports particularly consequential. Measles outbreaks have re-emerged across multiple U.S. states, and public health experts have repeatedly warned about declining vaccination coverage. When evidence-based communication is constrained for political reasons, clinicians, parents, and policymakers are deprived of the data they need to make informed choices — a dynamic that may accelerate vaccine hesitancy rather than address it.

It is worth noting that the FDA's credibility rests heavily on its perceived insulation from political pressure. Comparable concerns surfaced during the early COVID-19 pandemic, when career scientists publicly pushed back against what they viewed as politically motivated guidance. The current pattern, if confirmed and sustained, could have lasting effects not only on domestic immunization rates but also on the international standing of U.S. regulatory science. Global health agencies and peer regulators frequently rely on FDA assessments as a reference point, and any perception that those assessments are filtered through ideology could weaken that role over time.

entries.title: Anthropic's Claude Managed Agents can now "dream," sort of
entries.titleJa: AnthropicのClaude管理エージェント、「夢を見る」機能を追加
entries.titleEn: Anthropic's Claude Managed Agents can now "dream," sort of
entries.summaryJa: Anthropicは、Claudeの管理エージェントがアイドル時間に過去のタスクを再処理し、学習や記憶整理を行う「ドリーミング」機能を実装したと発表した。人間の睡眠中の記憶定着に着想を得たもので、AIエージェントの長期運用における性能向上を狙う。
entries.summaryEn: Anthropic has added a 'dreaming' capability to its Claude managed agents, letting them reprocess past tasks during idle periods to consolidate learning, loosely inspired by how human sleep aids memory.

image.alt: Anthropic's Claude Managed Agents can now "dream," sort of

entries.bodyJa:
Anthropicは、同社のClaude管理エージェント向けに「ドリーミング(dreaming)」と呼ばれる新機能を導入した。エージェントがアイドル状態の際に、過去に処理したタスクやコンテキストを内部的に再処理し、学習内容の定着や記憶の整理を行うという仕組みだ。長時間稼働するAIエージェントの一貫性や効率を高める狙いがあると見られる。

この機能は、人間が睡眠中にその日の出来事を脳内で再生し、記憶を長期化させる「メモリーコンソリデーション」のプロセスから着想を得ているとされる。具体的には、エージェントが空き時間にこれまでの対話ログや実行履歴を要約・抽象化し、将来のタスクで参照しやすい形に変換する処理を行う模様だ。これにより、長大なコンテキストを毎回ロードする負荷を減らしつつ、過去の経験を活かした応答が期待できる。

背景として、AIエージェントの「記憶」問題は業界共通の課題となっている。OpenAIのChatGPTにもメモリ機能が搭載されており、GoogleのGeminiやMicrosoftのCopilotも長期記憶や永続化に取り組んでいる。さらにLangChainやLlamaIndexといったオープンソースのエージェントフレームワークでも、ベクトルDBを用いた記憶管理が一般的だ。Anthropicの「ドリーミング」は、こうした静的なメモリ保存とは異なり、能動的な再処理という点でユニークな位置付けと言える。

一方で、アイドル時の計算リソース消費や、誤った記憶の強化(いわゆる幻覚の固定化)につながるリスクも指摘される可能性がある。Anthropic自身もConstitutional AIや解釈可能性研究で知られており、こうした自律的な内部処理の透明性をどう担保するかが今後の焦点になりそうだ。
entries.bodyEn:
Anthropic has rolled out a new capability for its Claude managed agents called 'dreaming,' which allows agents to reprocess prior tasks and context during idle periods. The feature is intended to help long-running AI agents consolidate what they have learned and operate more consistently across sessions.

The concept draws an explicit analogy to human sleep, during which the brain replays the day's experiences to strengthen long-term memory. In Claude's case, when an agent has no active workload it can revisit conversation logs and execution traces, summarizing or abstracting them into more compact representations that future tasks can reference. The aim appears to be reducing the burden of reloading enormous contexts on every invocation while still benefiting from accumulated experience.

Memory has emerged as one of the central unsolved problems for AI agents. OpenAI's ChatGPT has shipped a persistent memory feature, Google's Gemini and Microsoft's Copilot are exploring similar long-term retention, and open-source frameworks like LangChain and LlamaIndex routinely lean on vector databases to store and retrieve agent state. Anthropic's approach is notable for being more active: rather than simply writing facts to a store, the agent appears to perform a background consolidation pass, which is closer in spirit to offline reinforcement learning or experience replay than to a traditional memory layer.

There are open questions. Idle-time compute is not free, and reprocessing past interactions could entrench hallucinations or biases if errors get summarized as ground truth — a risk that may grow as agents accumulate longer histories. Anthropic, which has built much of its public identity around interpretability research and Constitutional AI, will likely face pressure to explain what exactly happens during these dreaming cycles and how users or operators can audit or constrain them.

The move also fits a broader industry trend toward agents that persist between sessions and act more like coworkers than chatbots. Anthropic has been steadily expanding Claude's agentic surface area, including computer use and tool orchestration, and dreaming can be read as another step toward agents that maintain a coherent sense of their own work over days or weeks. Whether the metaphor holds up in practice — and whether 'dreaming' delivers measurable gains in task quality rather than just marketing appeal — will depend on benchmarks and real-world deployments that have yet to be published.

entries.title: collab-staging: ep: Compute kept rate even when there's no matches (#55912)
entries.titleJa: Zed collab-staging: マッチ無しでも編集予測の保持率を計算
entries.titleEn: collab-staging: ep: Compute kept rate even when there's no matches (#55912)
entries.summaryJa: Zedのコラボレーションサーバーstaging環境向けリリース。編集予測（edit prediction）機能において、候補マッチが存在しない場合でも保持率（kept rate）を算出するよう修正された（PR #55912）。AI補完の品質計測精度の改善が目的と見られる。
entries.summaryEn: A Zed collab-staging release that fixes the edit prediction telemetry so the kept rate is computed even when there are no matches (PR #55912), improving the accuracy of quality metrics for Zed's AI-assisted completions.

image.alt: collab-staging: ep: Compute kept rate even when there's no matches (#55912)

entries.bodyJa:
Zedエディタのコラボレーションサーバー、staging環境向けに小規模な更新がリリースされた。今回の変更点は、編集予測（edit prediction）機能における「kept rate（採用率）」の計算ロジック修正で、PR #55912として取り込まれている。

具体的には、予測候補とユーザーの実際の編集がマッチしないケースにおいても、kept rateを算出するように改められた。従来はマッチが存在しない場合に計算がスキップされ、メトリクスから除外されていた可能性がある。これにより、ユーザーが提示された予測を採用しなかったケースも正しく分母に含まれ、機能の実際の有用性をより正確に把握できるようになると見られる。

ZedはRust製の高速なコードエディタで、近年はAIによる補完や次の編集箇所予測（edit prediction、Zeta モデル）に注力している。これはGitHub Copilotの「Next Edit Suggestions」やCursorのTabに相当する機能で、単なるカーソル位置の補完にとどまらず、ファイル内の他の編集ポイントを推測して提示する。こうした機能の改善には、実利用ログに基づくkept rateやacceptance rateといった指標が不可欠であり、テレメトリの正確性は次世代モデルの学習・評価にも直結する。

collab-stagingは本番環境（collab-production）に展開される前のリリース候補的な位置付けであり、開発チームが内部検証する段階のタグと見られる。一般ユーザー向けのZed本体アップデートではないが、サーバー側のメトリクス改善が積み重なることで、最終的にはエディタ体験の質向上につながる。
entries.bodyEn:
Zed has shipped a small update to its collaboration server's staging environment, tagged collab-staging. The notable change is a fix to the edit prediction telemetry pipeline: the kept rate is now computed even when there are no matches between predicted edits and what the user actually typed. The work landed as PR #55912.

Previously, when no candidate prediction matched a user's subsequent edits, the kept rate calculation was apparently skipped, which could have biased the metric upward by silently dropping zero-match cases from the denominator. With this change, those cases are accounted for, giving a more faithful picture of how often Zed's edit prediction suggestions are genuinely accepted in real-world use.

Zed is a Rust-based, performance-oriented code editor that has been investing heavily in AI-assisted features. Its edit prediction system, powered by the in-house Zeta model family, is conceptually similar to GitHub Copilot's Next Edit Suggestions or Cursor's Tab completion: rather than only completing text at the cursor, it tries to anticipate the next edit anywhere in the file and offers it inline. Building such systems well depends on tight feedback loops, and metrics like kept rate, acceptance rate, and dwell time are the bread and butter of evaluating both production quality and training data signals.

The collab-staging tag refers to Zed's collaboration backend running in a pre-production environment, used to validate server-side changes before they reach collab-production and, by extension, end users. It is not a client release, so users will not see new features in the editor itself from this tag. However, accurate telemetry is foundational: better measurement of when users keep or discard model predictions feeds directly into how Zed iterates on its Zeta models and tunes inference behavior. Small fixes like this one, while individually unremarkable, compound into more reliable evaluations and ultimately a sharper AI editing experience.

For teams building similar AI coding tools, this is a reminder that defining metrics carefully — including the no-match edge cases — matters as much as the model itself.

entries.title: This slim ice cream maker could fit in my already crowded kitchen
entries.titleJa: NutriBulletの薄型アイスクリームメーカーChillが登場
entries.titleEn: This slim ice cream maker could fit in my already crowded kitchen
entries.summaryJa: NutriBulletは、従来機より薄型化したアイスクリームメーカー「Chill」を200ドルで発売した。一晩の事前冷却が必要だが、20分でジェラートやソルベを作れる。Ninja Creamiの対抗馬として注目される。
entries.summaryEn: NutriBullet has launched the Chill, a slimmer $200 countertop ice cream maker that produces gelato, sorbet, and frozen yogurt in 20 minutes after an overnight pre-freeze of its bowl. It enters a category increasingly dominated by the Ninja Creami.

image.alt: This slim ice cream maker could fit in my already crowded kitchen

entries.bodyJa:
キッチン家電大手NutriBulletが、新型アイスクリームメーカー「Chill」を発表した。価格は200ドルで、すでに同社サイトおよびAmazonで販売されている。注目点は、競合製品より薄型に設計され、限られたカウンタースペースに収まりやすい点だ。

Chillは伝統的なフリーザーボウル方式を採用しており、使用前にボウルを冷凍庫で一晩(推奨16時間以上)冷やす必要がある。一度冷やしておけば、アイスクリーム、ジェラート、ソルベ、フローズンヨーグルトなどを約20分で作れる。容量は1.5クォートで、ハードアイスクリームやソフトサーブなど数種類の自動プログラムを備える。本体上部にミックスインを投入するシュートも設けられており、チョコチップやナッツを撹拌中に加えられる。

このカテゴリは近年、Ninja Creamiの大ヒットによって急速に注目を集めている。Creamiは事前に凍らせたベースを後から細かく削る独自方式で、ヘルシー志向のレシピやSNS映えする使い方が話題を呼び、家庭用アイスクリームメーカー市場を再活性化させた。NutriBullet ChillはCreamiとは異なり、撹拌しながら冷やす従来型のアプローチを取るが、より省スペースで価格帯も近く、ブレンダーで知名度のあるNutriBulletブランドの後押しもあって有力な選択肢となる可能性がある。

一方で、ボウル事前冷凍方式は思い立ってすぐ作れない弱点があり、コンプレッサー内蔵型(Breville Smart Scoopなど)に比べると即応性で劣る。とはいえコンプレッサー機は500ドル以上と高価で大型なため、Chillは価格・サイズ・機能のバランスを取った中間層向け製品と位置付けられそうだ。
entries.bodyEn:
NutriBullet, best known for its compact personal blenders, has expanded further into frozen desserts with the Chill, a new $200 countertop ice cream maker now available on the company's site and through Amazon. Its main selling point is a slimmer footprint than many rivals, making it easier to slot onto an already cluttered counter.

The Chill uses the traditional freezer-bowl approach: users must pre-chill the insulated bowl in a freezer for at least 16 hours before churning. Once frozen, the machine can produce ice cream, gelato, sorbet, or frozen yogurt in roughly 20 minutes. It holds about 1.5 quarts and offers several preset programs covering hard ice cream and soft serve textures. A chute on the lid lets users drop in mix-ins like chocolate chips or nuts mid-churn without halting the process.

The home ice cream maker category has heated up considerably over the past few years, largely thanks to the runaway success of the Ninja Creami. Rather than churning a liquid base into a frozen state, the Creami freezes the base first and then shaves and aerates it with a fast-spinning blade, an approach that resonated with health-conscious users blending protein powders, frozen fruit, and yogurts into single-serve pints. Social media buzz around Creami recipes has reinvigorated a once-sleepy appliance segment.

NutriBullet's Chill takes the more conventional churn-while-freezing route, which produces a different texture and requires advance planning. But it undercuts compressor-based machines such as the Breville Smart Scoop, which can run $500 or more and occupy substantial counter space because they freeze on demand without any pre-chilling. By avoiding a built-in compressor, NutriBullet keeps the Chill compact and relatively affordable, positioning it as a middle ground between cheap manual churners and pricey self-refrigerating units.

For shoppers already weighing a Creami against a classic churner, the Chill adds another credible option backed by a recognizable kitchen brand. Whether it can carve out meaningful space in a market increasingly defined by Ninja's blade-shaving approach remains to be seen, but its slim profile and familiar mechanics could appeal to buyers who prefer traditional scoopable textures over the Creami's denser, processed-style results.

entries.title: OpenMythosとは何者なのか？
entries.titleJa: OpenMythosとは何者か？謎のLLMモデルを検証する
entries.summaryJa: 記事はQiitaに投稿された「OpenMythos」と呼ばれるLLMモデルについての考察。出自不明のモデルがコミュニティで話題に上る背景や、ローカルLLMエコシステムにおける匿名・非公式モデルの位置づけを検討している。
entries.summaryEn: A Qiita post examines the mysterious LLM known as OpenMythos, exploring its unclear origins and considering how anonymous or unofficial models fit into the broader local-LLM ecosystem.
entries.bodyJa:
OpenMythosという名前のLLMモデルが一部コミュニティで取り沙汰されている。本記事はその正体を探ろうとするQiita投稿で、ローカルLLM界隈における出自不明モデルの扱いについて考察を加えている。

投稿者は、OpenMythosというモデルがどこから来たのか、誰が開発したのか、ベースモデルは何かといった基本情報が判然としない点に注目している。Hugging FaceやOllamaといった配布プラットフォームには、個人マージャーやファインチューナーによる派生モデルが日々大量に投稿されており、その中には命名だけがキャッチーで実態が掴みにくいものも少なくない。OpenMythosもそうした事例の一つとして検証対象になっていると見られる。

Mythos系の命名はGryphe氏の「MythoMax」などロールプレイ向けマージモデルで知られ、Llama2時代に人気を博した系譜がある。Open- というプレフィックスはOpenAIやOpenLLaMAなどを連想させるが、実際にはオープン性や系統を保証するものではない。匿名・準匿名のマージモデルが安易にこれらの語を冠することはコミュニティでも度々議論になっている。

背景として、ローカルLLMの普及によりGGUF形式での再配布や量子化モデルの派生が爆発的に増えた一方、ライセンス継承やベース明示が曖昧なケースが目立つ。利用者側はモデルカードや量子化元の追跡、必要なら推論時のプロンプト形式の確認を行うことが推奨される。OpenMythosが今後広く使われるかは未知数だが、こうした「素性確認」の文化は安全な活用に欠かせない要素となっている。
entries.bodyEn:
A Qiita post recently asked a simple but interesting question: what exactly is OpenMythos? The model's name has been circulating in some local-LLM circles, but its provenance remains unclear, and the author sets out to investigate.

The core observation is that OpenMythos lacks the basic transparency typically expected of a model release. There is no obvious indication of who trained it, what the base model is, or what data and methodology produced it. On platforms like Hugging Face and Ollama, individual merge authors and fine-tuners upload derivative models at a tremendous pace, and many of them carry catchy names without much accompanying documentation. OpenMythos appears to be one such case worth scrutinising.

The naming is itself suggestive. The Mythos lineage is closely associated with Gryphe's MythoMax and related roleplay-oriented merges that gained popularity during the Llama 2 era. The Open- prefix, meanwhile, evokes projects like OpenAI or OpenLLaMA, though in practice it guarantees neither openness nor any genealogical link. The community has occasionally pushed back against models that adopt these prefixes loosely, since they can mislead users about licensing, training data, or compatibility with established prompt formats.

Context matters here. As local inference has grown more accessible, the ecosystem has been flooded with GGUF redistributions, quantised variants, and merges of merges. While this creative churn has produced genuinely useful models, it has also made provenance harder to trace. Base model attribution is sometimes omitted, license inheritance is frequently unclear, and tokenizer or chat-template mismatches can quietly degrade output quality.

For a model like OpenMythos, the practical advice would be to check the model card carefully, identify the source of any quantisation, and verify the expected prompt template before drawing conclusions about its capabilities. Whether OpenMythos turns out to be a thoughtful merge, a rebadged variant of a known base, or something more obscure remains to be seen. Either way, the post is a useful reminder that in the local-LLM world, a healthy habit of asking who made this and from what is essential. That cultural practice of provenance-checking is becoming as important as benchmarks themselves.

entries.title: 個人のローカルMCPサーバーを claude.ai から呼ぶための、Cloudflare Tunnel + 自前OAuth 2.1実装
entries.titleJa: claude.aiから個人ローカルMCPサーバーを呼ぶ Cloudflare Tunnel + 自前OAuth 2.1実装
entries.summaryEn: A practical guide to exposing a personal local MCP server to claude.ai by combining Cloudflare Tunnel for public access with a self-built OAuth 2.1 authorization server for authentication.
entries.bodyJa:
Anthropicのclaude.aiが備えるリモートMCP(Model Context Protocol)連携機能を、個人開発のローカルMCPサーバーに対して使えるようにする実装ノートである。claude.aiのコネクタ機能はHTTPで到達可能かつOAuth 2.1で認証されたエンドポイントを要求するため、ローカル環境のままでは接続できない点が出発点となっている。

記事では二段構えの解決策が示されている。第一に、ローカルで動作するMCPサーバーをインターネットに公開する手段としてCloudflare Tunnel(cloudflared)を利用し、固定ドメインでHTTPS終端されたエンドポイントを得る。これによりポート開放やリバースプロキシの自前運用を回避できる。第二に、claude.aiが要求するOAuth 2.1のフローを満たす認可サーバーを自作し、Dynamic Client Registration、認可コード+PKCE、トークン発行といった必要最小限のエンドポイントを実装する流れが解説されている。

背景として、MCPは2024年末にAnthropicが公開した、LLMと外部ツール・データソースを接続するためのオープンプロトコルで、当初はローカルのstdio接続中心だったが、現在はHTTPベースのリモートMCPに対応が広がっている。claude.aiやClaude Desktop、ChatGPTのコネクタ等で採用が進む一方、リモート公開時の認証はOAuth 2.1準拠が事実上の標準となっており、個人開発者にとっては実装ハードルが高い領域でもある。

この種の課題に対しては、Cloudflare Workersが提供するMCPサーバー向けOAuthプロバイダーライブラリや、ngrok・Tailscale Funnelなどのトンネリングサービスといった代替手段も存在する。本記事のアプローチはそれらに頼らず、Cloudflare Tunnelの無料枠と最小限の自前OAuth実装を組み合わせる点で、仕組みを学びたい開発者向けの参考例として位置づけられると見られる。
entries.bodyEn:
A Japanese developer has published an implementation note describing how to connect a personally developed, locally running MCP (Model Context Protocol) server to Anthropic's claude.ai through its remote connector feature. The piece is notable because claude.ai's connector functionality requires endpoints that are reachable over HTTPS and authenticated via OAuth 2.1, conditions that a typical localhost setup does not satisfy out of the box.

The author proposes a two-part solution. The first part addresses network exposure: rather than opening ports on a home router or running a self-managed reverse proxy, the setup uses Cloudflare Tunnel (the cloudflared client) to publish the local MCP server to the internet behind a stable custom domain with HTTPS termination handled by Cloudflare's edge. This approach is attractive for hobbyist deployments because Cloudflare Tunnel offers a free tier and removes the need to manage TLS certificates or NAT traversal directly.

The second part tackles authentication. Because claude.ai expects an OAuth 2.1-compliant authorization server in front of the MCP endpoint, the article walks through building a minimal authorization server from scratch. The implementation reportedly covers the endpoints that claude.ai actually exercises during connector setup: Dynamic Client Registration (RFC 7591) so that claude.ai can register itself without manual client provisioning, the authorization code flow with PKCE for the user-consent step, and a token endpoint that issues access tokens consumed by subsequent MCP requests. The emphasis is on implementing only what is strictly necessary to satisfy the client, rather than producing a general-purpose identity provider.

For background, MCP is an open protocol introduced by Anthropic in late 2024 to standardize how large language models connect to external tools and data sources. Initial deployments centered on local stdio-based servers running alongside Claude Desktop, but the specification has since been extended to support HTTP-based remote servers. Adoption has broadened to include claude.ai's web connectors, Claude Desktop, and ChatGPT's connector ecosystem, among others. As remote MCP usage grows, OAuth 2.1 has effectively become the baseline authentication requirement for publicly reachable servers, which raises the bar for individual developers who want to expose their own tooling.

Several alternative paths exist for developers facing the same problem. Cloudflare Workers, for example, provides an OAuth provider library specifically aimed at MCP servers, abstracting much of the protocol-level work. Tunneling services such as ngrok and Tailscale Funnel can likewise expose a local server to the internet with HTTPS, sometimes paired with their own authentication layers. Managed MCP hosting offerings are also beginning to appear. The approach described in the article deliberately avoids these higher-level abstractions, combining Cloudflare Tunnel's free tier with a hand-rolled OAuth implementation. That choice appears to be motivated less by cost than by a desire to understand the moving parts of the protocol stack.

From a practical standpoint, the write-up may serve as a useful reference for developers who want to experiment with personal MCP servers without committing to a serverless platform or a paid tunneling plan. It also illustrates the minimum surface area of OAuth 2.1 that an MCP client like claude.ai exercises in practice, which can be informative for anyone evaluating how much of the specification they actually need to implement. Readers should note, however, that a minimal hand-written authorization server carries real security responsibilities — including correct PKCE verification, token storage, and scope handling — and may be best suited to single-user, personal deployments rather than multi-tenant scenarios.

The broader takeaway is that the remote MCP ecosystem is still in an early phase where individual developers are documenting and sharing the integration patterns that work. As the protocol matures and more libraries emerge on both the server and client sides, the friction described in this article is likely to decrease, but for now, combining a tunneling service with a focused OAuth implementation appears to be a viable route for bringing personal tools into hosted LLM clients.

entries.title: 5 gardening tips you can try right in Search
entries.titleJa: Google検索で試せるガーデニング活用術5選
entries.titleEn: 5 gardening tips you can try right in Search
entries.summaryJa: Googleは検索機能を使った家庭菜園や園芸のコツを5つ紹介。AI Modeでの植物選定、Lensによる雑草・害虫の識別、3D表示、栽培カレンダーなど、検索を起点にしたガーデニング支援機能をまとめている。
entries.summaryEn: Google highlights five ways to use Search for gardening, including AI Mode for plant recommendations, Lens for identifying weeds and pests, 3D plant views, and seasonal planting guides.

image.alt: 5 gardening tips you can try right in Search

entries.bodyJa:
Googleは公式ブログで、検索機能を使って家庭菜園やガーデニングを楽しむための5つの活用法を紹介した。季節の変わり目に庭仕事を始めるユーザー向けに、AIや画像認識を組み合わせた機能群をまとめた内容となっている。

第一に挙げられているのは、AI Modeを使った植物選びだ。「日陰に強く鹿に食べられにくい多年草」といった複合的な条件を自然文で問いかけると、生育環境に合った候補を提示してくれる。従来のキーワード検索では難しかったニッチな園芸相談を、対話形式で解決できる点が特徴だ。

次に、Google Lensを用いた植物・雑草・害虫の識別機能が紹介されている。スマートフォンのカメラを向けるだけで種類を判別し、対処法や育て方の情報にたどり着ける。さらに一部の植物については3Dモデルを検索結果に表示でき、購入前に庭に置いた際のサイズ感を確認できるという。

このほか、地域に合わせた植え付け時期のガイドや、収穫物を活用したレシピ検索なども取り上げられている。検索を起点として、計画から育成、収穫後の調理までを一貫してサポートする方向性が見て取れる。

背景として、植物識別の分野ではPlantNetやiNaturalist、PictureThisといった専門アプリが先行しており、Googleは汎用検索の強みとAI Modeの自然言語理解を組み合わせて差別化を図っているとみられる。Geminiベースの生成AIを検索体験に統合する流れの一環であり、園芸というニッチな日常領域にもAI機能を浸透させる狙いがある可能性がある。
entries.bodyEn:
Google has published a blog post outlining five ways its Search products can help home gardeners, framing the feature roundup as a seasonal guide for users picking up a trowel for the first time or planning their next planting cycle.

The first tip centers on AI Mode in Search, which lets users pose complex, natural-language questions such as asking for shade-tolerant perennials that resist deer browsing. Instead of stitching together multiple keyword queries, gardeners can describe their conditions and constraints conversationally and receive curated plant suggestions. This represents a clear use case for generative search, where ambiguous, multi-criteria questions historically returned shallow results.

The second highlight is Google Lens, which can identify unfamiliar plants, weeds, and insect pests from a smartphone photo. Pointing the camera at a leaf or bug surfaces species information along with care or treatment guidance, lowering the barrier for novice gardeners who might otherwise struggle to diagnose problems in their beds.

Google also points to 3D views of select plants directly in Search results, letting shoppers visualize mature size and shape before buying. Rounding out the list are localized planting calendars tied to regional growing seasons, and recipe discovery for using whatever the garden produces at harvest time. Together, the features sketch a workflow that spans planning, growing, troubleshooting, and cooking.

For context, plant identification has been a competitive niche for years, with dedicated apps such as PlantNet, iNaturalist, and PictureThis building large reference databases and active user communities. Google's advantage likely lies in folding identification into a general-purpose search experience that most users already open daily, rather than asking them to install a vertical app. The integration of AI Mode, which is built on Gemini models, also suggests Google sees everyday hobby domains as a useful proving ground for conversational search beyond productivity and shopping queries.

While the blog post is light on new product announcements and reads largely as a seasonal marketing roundup, it offers a snapshot of how Google is positioning Search as an ambient assistant for offline activities. Whether gardeners will reach for Search over specialized communities like Reddit's r/gardening or regional extension service websites remains to be seen, but the company appears intent on demonstrating that AI-enhanced search has utility well outside the office.

entries.title: Live blog: Code w/ Claude 2026
entries.titleJa: Simon Willison、Code w/ Claude 2026をライブブログ
entries.titleEn: Live blog: Code w/ Claude 2026
entries.summaryJa: Simon Willisonが、Anthropicの開発者向けカンファレンス「Code w/ Claude 2026」のライブブログを公開した。ClaudeとClaude Codeに関する新発表や技術セッションの内容をリアルタイムで記録していると見られる。
entries.summaryEn: Simon Willison is live-blogging Anthropic's Code w/ Claude 2026 developer conference, capturing announcements and technical sessions related to Claude and Claude Code in real time.
entries.bodyJa:
独立系開発者でありAI関連の精力的なブロガーとして知られるSimon Willisonが、Anthropic主催の開発者向けカンファレンス「Code w/ Claude 2026」をライブブログ形式で記録している。会期中の発表内容や技術セッションを逐次的にまとめる試みで、参加できない開発者にとって貴重な一次情報源となる可能性がある。

Code w/ Claudeは、AnthropicがClaudeおよびClaude Code、APIエコシステムを中心に開発者向けの技術情報を提供するイベントとして位置づけられている。前年(2025年)に初開催されており、今回はその二回目となる見込みだ。Claude Codeはターミナル上で動作するエージェント型コーディングツールで、ファイル編集、コマンド実行、Git操作などを自然言語の指示で行える点が特徴で、近年急速にユーザーを増やしている。

Willisonのライブブログは、彼が長年運用しているsimonwillison.net上で公開されており、過去にもOpenAI DevDayやGoogle I/Oなど主要AIイベントでも同様の形式で速報を提供してきた実績がある。彼自身はLLM関連のオープンソースツール「llm」CLIの開発者でもあり、技術的な視点からの解説には定評がある。

競合であるOpenAIのDevDayやGoogleのGemini関連発表と並び、Anthropicのカンファレンスは生成AI業界の方向性を占ううえで注目度が高い。特にエージェント型開発支援ツールの分野はGitHub Copilot、Cursor、Windsurfなどとの競合が激しく、Claude Codeに関する新機能やモデル更新の発表があれば業界へのインパクトは大きいと見られる。詳細な発表内容は本人のライブブログで随時更新される見込みだ。
entries.bodyEn:
Simon Willison, the independent developer and prolific AI blogger, is live-blogging Anthropic's Code w/ Claude 2026 conference. His running notes from the event are likely to serve as a valuable primary source for developers unable to attend in person, capturing announcements, demos, and technical sessions as they happen.

Code w/ Claude is Anthropic's developer-focused conference, centered on the Claude family of models, the Claude Code agentic CLI tool, and the broader API ecosystem. The inaugural event was held in 2025, making this the second iteration. Claude Code itself has gained significant traction over the past year as a terminal-based coding agent capable of editing files, running commands, and managing Git operations through natural-language instructions, putting it in direct competition with tools like GitHub Copilot, Cursor, and Windsurf.

Willison has built a reputation for thorough live-blog coverage of major AI industry events, including OpenAI's DevDay and Google I/O sessions on Gemini. As the creator of the open-source llm CLI tool and Datasette, he brings a hands-on technical perspective that tends to highlight practical implications for working developers rather than just marketing narratives. His posts often include code snippets, observations about pricing and rate limits, and candid commentary on how new capabilities compare with competing offerings.

Anthropic's conference is being closely watched alongside parallel events from OpenAI and Google as a bellwether for the direction of the generative AI industry. The agentic coding tools space in particular has become intensely competitive, with model providers and IDE startups racing to deliver more autonomous workflows. Any announcements around new Claude model versions, expanded Claude Code capabilities, pricing changes, or enterprise features would carry meaningful weight for the developer ecosystem.

Readers interested in the specifics should follow Willison's blog directly, as the post is being updated continuously throughout the event. Given the live-blog format, the entry likely grows in depth and detail over the course of the conference, and may end up being one of the more comprehensive third-party recaps available once the event concludes.

entries.title: Claudeのcomputer-useでMacのサードパーティアプリが認識されない問題と解決方法
entries.titleJa: Claudeのcomputer-useでMacのサードパーティアプリが認識されない問題と解決方法
entries.summaryJa: AnthropicのClaude computer-use機能をMacで利用する際、Chromeなどサードパーティアプリが操作対象として認識されない問題が発生する。原因はmacOSのアクセシビリティ権限不足で、システム設定から該当アプリに権限を付与することで解決できる。
entries.summaryEn: When using Anthropic's Claude computer-use feature on macOS, third-party apps like Chrome may not be recognized as control targets. The fix is to grant accessibility permissions to those apps in System Settings.
entries.bodyJa:
Anthropicが提供するClaudeのcomputer-use機能は、AIがマウスやキーボードを操作してPC上のアプリを自律的に動かせる画期的な仕組みだが、macOS環境ではChromeなどサードパーティ製アプリが操作対象として正しく認識されない事象が報告されている。

本記事の筆者によれば、Claude Desktopやcomputer-use経由でブラウザを起動・操作させようとしても、対象アプリのウィンドウが取得できず処理が止まってしまうという。原因はAIの不具合ではなく、macOS側のセキュリティ機構にある。Appleはユーザーの画面情報や入力イベントへのアクセスを「アクセシビリティ」「画面収録」といった権限で厳格に管理しており、これらが付与されていないアプリはAIエージェントから操作対象として可視化されない。

解決策はシンプルで、システム設定のプライバシーとセキュリティから「アクセシビリティ」および必要に応じて「画面収録」項目を開き、Claude本体やターミナル、ChromeなどのサードパーティアプリにON設定を行えばよい。設定後はアプリの再起動が必要となるケースもある。

こうした権限まわりの摩擦は、computer-useに限らずGoogleのProject MarinerやOpenAIのOperatorなど、いわゆるエージェント型AIをデスクトップで動作させる際に共通して発生し得る課題と見られる。OSベンダーの安全性設計とAIの自律操作を両立させるためには、ユーザー側での明示的な許可フローが当面不可欠となる可能性が高い。今後はAppleやMicrosoftがエージェント向けに最適化された権限モデルを提供していく流れも考えられ、開発者・利用者ともにOSの権限管理に対する理解が一層重要になる。
entries.bodyEn:
Anthropic's Claude computer-use feature lets the model drive a desktop autonomously by controlling the mouse and keyboard, but on macOS users have reported that third-party apps such as Google Chrome are sometimes not recognized as controllable targets.

According to the author, attempts to have Claude open or manipulate Chrome via Claude Desktop or the computer-use tooling can stall because the agent fails to enumerate or focus the target application's windows. The root cause is not a defect in Claude itself but rather macOS's strict permission model. Apple gates access to screen contents and synthetic input events behind the Accessibility and Screen Recording privacy categories, and any process that lacks those entitlements is effectively invisible to an automation agent.

The fix is straightforward. Open System Settings, navigate to Privacy and Security, and enable Accessibility (and Screen Recording where relevant) for the Claude app, the terminal running the computer-use bridge, and the third-party apps being controlled, including Chrome. A restart of the affected apps is sometimes required for the new permissions to take effect.

This kind of permissions friction is not unique to Anthropic's offering. Similar hurdles can be expected with other agentic desktop systems such as Google's Project Mariner or OpenAI's Operator, since any AI that drives a real OS must negotiate with the platform's sandboxing and accessibility layers. For the foreseeable future, an explicit user consent flow is likely to remain a prerequisite for safe agentic automation, balancing OS-level security guarantees with the open-ended actions an LLM might attempt.

Looking ahead, it is plausible that Apple and Microsoft will introduce permission models tailored specifically to AI agents, perhaps with finer-grained scopes or time-limited grants. Until then, both developers building on computer-use and end users experimenting with it will need a working understanding of macOS privacy settings to avoid silent failures that can easily be mistaken for model limitations.

entries.title: Chrome on Android now supports approximate instead of precise location sharing
entries.titleJa: Android版Chrome、位置情報を「おおよそ」共有可能に
entries.titleEn: Chrome on Android now supports approximate instead of precise location sharing
entries.summaryJa: GoogleはAndroid版Chromeに、サイトへ正確な位置情報ではなくおおよその位置情報を共有できる新オプションを追加した。プライバシー保護を強化しつつ、位置ベースのサービスは利用可能。Android 12以降のOSレベル機能をブラウザに統合した形だ。
entries.summaryEn: Google has added an option in Chrome for Android that lets users share approximate location with websites instead of precise GPS coordinates, improving privacy while still enabling location-based services. The change brings an Android 12-era OS feature into the browser layer.

image.alt: Chrome on Android now supports approximate instead of precise location sharing

entries.bodyJa:
Googleは、Android版Chromeに、ウェブサイトへ共有する位置情報の精度をユーザーが選択できる新機能を追加した。これにより、正確な座標を渡す代わりに「おおよその位置」を共有することが可能になり、プライバシー保護とサービス利用の両立が図れる。

位置情報の許可を求めるダイアログには「正確」と「おおよそ」を切り替えるトグルが表示される。おおよそモードでは、ユーザーの実際の現在地から数キロメートル単位でぼかされた地点が返される仕組みと見られ、天気・地域ニュース・近隣の店舗検索など、厳密な座標を必要としないユースケースに十分な精度を提供する。一方で、ターン・バイ・ターンのナビや配車のような用途には正確モードが引き続き必要となる。

この仕組み自体は新しい発想ではない。Androidは2021年のAndroid 12でネイティブアプリ向けに「approximate location」許可を導入しており、iOSも14以降で同様の精度制御をシステムレベルで提供している。Chromeは長らくOS側の位置情報パーミッションをそのままウェブに渡す形だったため、ブラウザUI上で個別にぼかしを選べるようになった点は、ウェブとアプリ間のプライバシー機能格差を埋める動きと位置づけられる。

背景には、フィンガープリンティング対策やCookie廃止議論など、Googleが進めるプライバシー関連の一連の取り組みがある。とはいえGoogle自身が広告事業を抱えるため、こうした粒度制御がデフォルトでどこまで強く適用されるかは引き続き注目される点だろう。FirefoxやBraveなど他ブラウザでも、位置情報を含むAPIへの粒度制御や偽装機能が以前から議論されており、ウェブ標準としてのPermissions APIにも今後反映される可能性がある。
entries.bodyEn:
Google has rolled out a new option in Chrome for Android that lets users decide how precisely a website can see their location. Instead of being forced to choose between sharing exact GPS coordinates or denying access entirely, users can now opt to share an approximate location, striking a more practical balance between privacy and functionality.

When a site requests location access, the permission prompt now exposes a toggle between Precise and Approximate. In approximate mode, the browser returns a coarsened position — likely fuzzed to within a few kilometers of the user's real coordinates — which is sufficient for use cases such as weather, local news, regional pricing, or finding nearby stores. Apps that genuinely need pinpoint accuracy, such as turn-by-turn navigation or ride-hailing, can still request the precise option.

The concept itself is not new. Android introduced an approximate location permission for native apps back in Android 12 in 2021, and iOS has offered similar precision controls at the system level since iOS 14. Chrome, however, traditionally forwarded whatever the OS granted directly to web content, meaning websites effectively saw the same accuracy as native apps. Surfacing this control inside the browser UI helps close a long-standing gap between the privacy affordances available to web pages and those enjoyed by installed apps.

The move fits within Google's broader, if sometimes contested, privacy narrative around Chrome — including its work on fingerprinting mitigations, the Privacy Sandbox, and ongoing debates about third-party cookies. Because Google's core business depends on advertising, observers are likely to watch how aggressively the approximate option is presented by default and whether it becomes the suggested choice for routine permission prompts.

Other browsers have explored similar territory. Firefox has discussed coarsening various web APIs as part of its anti-tracking efforts, and Brave has shipped fingerprint randomization for sensors and other signals. The W3C's Permissions and Geolocation specifications could eventually formalize a standardized accuracy hint, which would make this kind of user-facing control more consistent across browsers rather than a Chrome-specific UX choice.

For developers, the practical takeaway is that geolocation responses may now be noticeably less precise for a growing share of users, and applications should be designed to degrade gracefully when only an approximate fix is available. For end users, it is one more small but meaningful lever in deciding how much of their real-world movement is exposed to the web.

entries.title: 久々に個人開発するのでPowerShell HookでClaude CodeのWindows11ハーネスを作った覚書
entries.titleJa: PowerShell HookでClaude CodeのWindows 11向けハーネスを自作した記録
entries.summaryJa: 個人開発の再開にあたり、Claude CodeをWindows 11上で快適に使うため、PowerShellのフック機構を活用した独自ハーネスを構築した経緯をまとめた個人ブログ。環境構築の工夫や運用上の気づきを共有している。
entries.summaryEn: A personal blog post documenting the author's effort to build a Windows 11 harness for Claude Code using PowerShell hooks, sharing setup choices and lessons learned while resuming solo development.
entries.bodyJa:
久しぶりに個人開発へ復帰した筆者が、AnthropicのClaude CodeをWindows 11環境で活用するためにPowerShellのフック機構を用いて独自のハーネス(実行補助環境)を構築した過程を記した覚書である。CLI型のAIコーディングエージェントをローカル開発に組み込む際の実践例として参考になる。

Claude Codeは元々macOSやLinuxといったUNIX系シェルでの利用を前提とした作りが強く、Windows環境ではWSL経由での実行が一般的とされている。筆者はあえてネイティブのPowerShellに統合する道を選び、コマンド実行の前後にフックを差し込むことで、ログ収集や安全確認、補助スクリプト呼び出しなどを行えるようにしたと見られる。

背景として、Claude CodeにはHooksと呼ばれる仕組みがあり、ツール実行の前後やセッション開始時などに任意のコマンドを差し込める。これを利用して権限制御や監査ログを実装する例はコミュニティでも増えており、Cursor、Aider、OpenAI Codex CLIといった同種ツールでも類似の拡張が試みられている。Windowsネイティブで動かすことで、WSLとの間で生じがちなパス変換やファイルシステム性能の課題を回避できる可能性がある。

一方で、Windows環境ではシェル差異やエンコーディング(UTF-8とCP932の混在)に起因するトラブルが起きやすく、PowerShellでのフック実装には実行ポリシーや引数エスケープへの配慮が必要になる。本記事は商用プロダクトの発表ではなく個人開発者の作業記録だが、同様の構成を試みたい開発者にとっては実装上の落とし穴を避けるヒントになり得る内容と言える。
entries.bodyEn:
This Zenn post is a personal field note from a developer returning to side-project work, documenting how they built a custom harness around Anthropic's Claude Code on Windows 11 using PowerShell's hook mechanism. It serves as a practical reference for anyone trying to fit a CLI-based AI coding agent into a native Windows workflow.

Claude Code was designed with UNIX-like shells in mind, and on Windows the common recommendation is to run it under WSL. The author instead chose to integrate it directly with PowerShell, wiring hooks around command execution to handle things like logging, safety checks, and auxiliary script invocation. The post reads as an incremental memo rather than a polished tutorial, but it captures the kind of friction that surfaces when adapting a Linux-first tool to a Windows-first machine.

For context, Claude Code exposes a Hooks feature that lets users inject arbitrary commands at lifecycle points such as before or after tool execution and at session start. The community has been using these hooks for permission gating, audit logging, and integration with local linters or test runners. Similar extensibility patterns can be seen in competing agents like Cursor, Aider, and OpenAI's Codex CLI, suggesting that lightweight, hook-based customization is becoming a de facto pattern for terminal-native AI coding tools.

Running natively on Windows can sidestep some annoyances of the WSL route, such as path translation between Windows and Linux filesystems and the well-known performance penalty when crossing the 9P boundary. However, it introduces its own set of issues: PowerShell execution policies, argument quoting differences from bash, and the perennial UTF-8 versus CP932 encoding mismatch that still bites Japanese Windows users in particular. The author appears to have navigated these by leaning on PowerShell-native scripting rather than shimming bash-style hooks.

This is not a vendor announcement or a major release, but rather a hobbyist's working notes. Still, as more developers experiment with agentic coding tools outside their original target environments, these kinds of grounded write-ups may prove more useful than official documentation for understanding the rough edges. Readers considering a similar setup should likely treat the post as a starting point and validate behavior against their own toolchain, since hook APIs in this space are still evolving and may change as Claude Code matures.

entries.title: Google updates AI search to include quotes from Reddit and other sources
entries.titleJa: Google、AI検索にRedditなど専門家の声を引用追加
entries.titleEn: Google updates AI search to include quotes from Reddit and other sources
entries.summaryJa: GoogleはAI検索機能を更新し、RedditやQuoraなどのウェブフォーラムから専門家や経験者の意見を引用して表示するようにした。検索結果に多様な視点を加え、ユーザーの実体験に基づく情報提供を強化する狙いがある。
entries.summaryEn: Google has updated its AI search to surface quotes from Reddit, Quora, and other web forums, aiming to bring real-world expert and user perspectives directly into AI-generated answers.

image.alt: Google updates AI search to include quotes from Reddit and other sources

entries.bodyJa:
Googleは検索のAI機能を強化し、RedditやQuoraといったオンラインフォーラムから引用された専門家や経験者の声を表示するアップデートを発表した。AIが生成する要約に「人間の生の声」を組み込むことで、信頼性と実用性を高める狙いがある。

新機能では、ユーザーが質問を入力すると、AI Overviews(AIによる要約)の一部としてフォーラム投稿の引用が表示される。たとえば旅行の計画や製品レビュー、専門的なハウツーといった「経験に基づく回答」が求められるクエリで、実際にその分野に詳しいユーザーの投稿を抜粋して提示する仕組みだ。引用元へのリンクも併記され、ユーザーは元の議論にアクセスできる。

背景には、AI生成コンテンツが氾濫するなか、検索結果に「本物の人間の意見」を求める動きが強まっていることがある。実際、ユーザーが検索クエリの末尾に「reddit」を付けて検索する行動はここ数年で顕著に増えており、Google自身も2024年にRedditとデータ提携を結んだことが報じられている。今回の機能はその提携を活かした自然な発展形と見られる。

一方で、フォーラムの投稿は必ずしも正確とは限らず、誤情報や偏った意見が混入するリスクも指摘されている。過去にはGoogleのAI Overviewsが、Redditのジョーク投稿を真に受けて「ピザにのりを使う」と回答した事例もあり、引用元の品質管理は引き続き課題となる可能性がある。

競合のPerplexityやMicrosoftのCopilotも同様にウェブ全体の情報を統合するアプローチを採っており、AI検索における「ソースの多様性」と「信頼性」のバランスは業界共通のテーマとなっている。
entries.bodyEn:
Google is updating its AI-powered search experience to incorporate quotes from web forums such as Reddit and Quora, aiming to inject authentic human voices into AI-generated answers. The change reflects an industry-wide push to balance algorithmic synthesis with lived experience.

Under the update, Google's AI Overviews will display excerpted quotes from forum users alongside the synthesized answer. The feature targets queries where personal experience matters most — travel recommendations, product comparisons, niche how-to questions — and surfaces snippets from people who appear to have hands-on knowledge of the topic. Links to the original threads accompany the quotes, letting users dig deeper into the broader conversation.

The move builds on a clear shift in user behavior. Over the past few years, appending "reddit" to a Google query has become a popular trick for cutting through SEO-optimized content farms and finding genuine discussion. Google formally acknowledged this trend in 2024 when it struck a data-licensing deal with Reddit, reportedly worth around $60 million annually, giving it structured access to the forum's content for training and search indexing. The new quoting feature looks like a natural extension of that partnership.

There are caveats. Forum posts are not vetted, and Google's AI has stumbled before when leaning too heavily on Reddit content. Last year, AI Overviews infamously suggested users add glue to pizza sauce — advice traced back to a years-old joke comment on Reddit. Ensuring that surfaced quotes come from credible contributors, rather than trolls or outdated threads, will likely remain a moderation challenge.

The broader context is competitive. Perplexity has built its reputation on transparent, citation-heavy answers, while Microsoft's Copilot and OpenAI's ChatGPT search increasingly weave together sources from across the web. By foregrounding community voices, Google may be trying to differentiate its AI search as more grounded in real-world experience, rather than purely encyclopedic. Whether users trust those voices — and whether forum communities welcome the additional traffic or resent the scraping — will shape how the feature evolves.

For publishers and forum moderators, the update raises familiar questions about attribution and traffic. Direct quoting may drive some click-throughs, but if AI Overviews satisfy the query in place, the underlying communities could see diminishing returns even as their content powers Google's answers.

entries.title: nightly: editor: Support file:line:col navigation from hover links (#55877)
entries.titleJa: Zed nightly、ホバーリンクからfile:line:col形式の遷移をサポート
entries.titleEn: nightly: editor: Support file:line:col navigation from hover links (#55877)
entries.summaryJa: Zedエディタのnightlyビルドで、ホバー時に表示されるリンクから「file:line:col」形式のパス指定によるナビゲーションが可能になった。エラーログやスタックトレースに含まれる位置情報付きのファイル参照を直接クリックして開けるようになり、デバッグ作業の効率化に寄与する更新となっている。
entries.summaryEn: Zed's nightly build now supports navigating from hover links using the file:line:col format, letting developers click on file references with position information (such as those in stack traces or compiler output) to jump directly to the exact location in the editor.

image.alt: nightly: editor: Support file:line:col navigation from hover links (#55877)

entries.bodyJa:
Rust製の高速エディタZedのnightlyビルドにおいて、ホバー時に表示されるリンクから「file:line:col」形式のパス指定によるナビゲーションがサポートされた。プルリクエスト#55877によって追加された比較的小さな改善ながら、日常のデバッグ作業に直接効くアップデートである。

プログラミングにおいて、エラーメッセージやスタックトレース、コンパイラ出力には「src/main.rs:42:10」のように、ファイルパスに加えて行番号と列番号がコロン区切りで付加された参照表記が広く使われる。RustやTypeScript、Pythonなど多くの言語のツールチェーンがこの形式を採用しており、ターミナルエミュレータ側でも同形式のリンク化対応が進んでいる。今回の変更により、Zed内部のホバー表示でこうした参照を検出した際に、クリック一つで該当ファイルの該当行・該当列にカーソルを移動できる。

類似の機能はVS CodeやJetBrains系IDEでも長らく標準的にサポートされてきたほか、iTerm2やWezTerm、Ghosttyといったモダンなターミナルでも「Cmd+クリック」によるエディタ起動に対応している。Zedはコラボレーション機能やGPUレンダリングを売りに急速に機能追加を進めており、こうした地味だが重要なエディタとしての基本的な使い勝手の底上げを継続している点が特徴的だ。

なお本変更はnightlyチャネルへの取り込みであり、stableリリースに反映される時期は別途のリリースサイクルに依存すると見られる。挙動の詳細やエッジケース(相対パスの解決基準、Windowsスタイルのドライブレター付きパスへの対応など)については、実際にnightlyを試すか、PRの議論を確認するのが確実だろう。
entries.bodyEn:
The nightly build of Zed, the Rust-based collaborative code editor, has gained support for navigating from hover links that use the common file:line:col path format. Introduced via PR #55877, the change is small in scope but directly improves day-to-day debugging workflows.

In most language ecosystems, error messages, stack traces, and compiler diagnostics conventionally encode source locations as a path followed by colon-separated line and column numbers, such as src/main.rs:42:10. Rust's compiler, TypeScript's tsc, Python tracebacks, and countless linters all emit this format. With this update, when Zed renders such a reference inside a hover popup, clicking it will jump straight to the indicated file at the precise row and column rather than merely opening the file at its top.

This kind of navigation has long been table stakes for editors like VS Code and the JetBrains family, and modern terminal emulators such as iTerm2, WezTerm, and Ghostty have also embraced the file:line:col convention for Cmd-click handoff to an editor. Zed has been aggressive about shipping headline features like real-time collaboration and GPU-accelerated rendering, but updates like this one show ongoing investment in the more mundane plumbing that determines whether an editor feels pleasant under daily use.

Because the change lands on the nightly channel, it will likely take some time before it propagates to the stable release, depending on Zed's normal promotion cadence. Edge cases — for example, how relative paths are resolved against the current workspace, or whether Windows-style paths with drive letters are handled gracefully — are not fully clear from the release note alone, and interested users may want to consult the PR discussion or experiment with the nightly build directly to confirm the exact behavior.

entries.title: Khosla-backed robotics startup Genesis AI has gone full stack, demo shows
entries.titleJa: Khosla出資のGenesis AI、フルスタック型ロボのデモを公開
entries.titleEn: Khosla-backed robotics startup Genesis AI has gone full stack, demo shows
entries.summaryJa: Khosla Venturesが支援するロボティクス新興企業Genesis AIが、ハードウェアとAIモデルを自社開発するフルスタック戦略を採用したことをデモで明らかにした。汎用ロボット基盤モデルと独自ロボの統合を進めており、汎用ロボ市場の競争激化を象徴する動きとなる。
entries.summaryEn: Khosla Ventures-backed robotics startup Genesis AI has revealed via a new demo that it has gone full stack, building both its own robot hardware and foundation AI models. The move signals intensifying competition in the general-purpose robotics race.

image.alt: Khosla-backed robotics startup Genesis AI has gone full stack, demo shows

entries.bodyJa:
Khosla Venturesが出資するロボティクス・スタートアップのGenesis AIが、新たなデモを通じてフルスタック戦略への転換を明らかにした。同社はAIモデルだけでなく、自社開発のロボットハードウェアまで手掛ける垂直統合型企業を目指すという。

Genesis AIはもともと、ロボット学習向けの高性能シミュレーション環境「Genesis」を開発するプロジェクトとして注目を集めた。物理シミュレーションを高速に行い、合成データで汎用ロボット用の基盤モデル(いわゆるロボティクス・ファウンデーションモデル)を学習させるアプローチをとってきた。今回のデモでは、そのモデルを自社設計のロボット本体に搭載し、現実環境での動作を披露した形と見られる。

フルスタック戦略は、Tesla Optimus、Figure AI、1X Technologies、Physical Intelligence(π)、Skild AIなど、汎用ロボットを掲げる主要プレイヤーの間で広がりつつある潮流だ。ハードとソフトを切り離すと最適化が難しく、データ収集・学習・展開のループを自社で握ることが競争優位につながると考えられているためである。一方で、開発コストや組織運営の難度は跳ね上がるため、十分な資金調達と人材確保が前提となる。

Khosla VenturesはOpenAIへの初期投資でも知られる著名VCで、AI分野への積極投資を続けている。同社が支援するGenesis AIがハードウェアまで踏み込んだことは、ロボティクス基盤モデル領域への投資家の期待値の高さを示す動きと言える。

ただし、デモ動画と実環境での汎化性能の間には依然として大きな隔たりがあるのが業界共通の課題だ。Genesis AIの今回の発表が量産や商用展開にどこまで結び付くかは、今後のベンチマーク公開や顧客導入事例を待つ必要があるだろう。
entries.bodyEn:
Genesis AI, a robotics startup backed by Khosla Ventures, has signaled a strategic shift toward full-stack development, according to a newly released demo. The company is now building both its own robot hardware and the AI foundation models that drive it, joining a growing cohort of vertically integrated humanoid and general-purpose robotics ventures.

Genesis AI first drew attention through its eponymous high-performance physics simulator, which the team positioned as a way to generate massive volumes of synthetic training data for robot learning. That simulation-first approach underpins what the company calls a robotics foundation model — a general policy intended to transfer across tasks and embodiments. The new demo appears to show that model running on hardware Genesis itself designed, suggesting the firm no longer wants to rely on third-party platforms to validate its software.

Going full stack has become something of an industry default among the most ambitious players in general-purpose robotics. Tesla's Optimus program, Figure AI, 1X Technologies, Physical Intelligence and Skild AI have all argued, in varying ways, that owning the data-collection-to-deployment loop is essential for steady model improvement. Decoupling hardware from the learning stack tends to introduce friction in sensor calibration, latency budgets and teleoperation data quality — all of which directly affect how well a foundation model can be trained and fine-tuned.

The trade-off is cost and complexity. Designing actuators, hands and whole-body platforms is capital-intensive and requires mechanical, electrical and manufacturing expertise that pure-software AI labs often lack. That makes investor backing critical. Khosla Ventures, an early backer of OpenAI and a consistent bettor on frontier AI, lending support to Genesis AI's hardware ambitions is itself a notable signal about where capital is flowing in the robotics stack.

It is worth tempering expectations, however. Curated demo videos have historically overstated the real-world generalization of robot policies, and the field still lacks widely accepted benchmarks for evaluating foundation models in unstructured environments. Whether Genesis AI's integrated approach translates into reliable commercial deployments will likely depend on forthcoming third-party evaluations, pilot customers and the company's ability to scale manufacturing — areas where even well-funded competitors continue to struggle.

entries.title: LLM-as-a-Judge を作る前に、人がログを読む
entries.titleJa: LLM-as-a-Judge を作る前に、まず人がログを読むべき理由
entries.summaryJa: LLMの評価を自動化する前に、開発者自身が実際のログを読み込むことの重要性を説く記事。人手によるエラーパターンの把握なしに評価器を構築しても、信頼できる品質指標は得られないと指摘する。
entries.summaryEn: This article argues that before building an LLM-as-a-Judge evaluator, developers must first manually read production logs to understand failure modes, since automated judges built without human grounding tend to produce unreliable quality signals.

image.alt: LLM-as-a-Judge を作る前に、人がログを読む

entries.bodyJa:
LLMアプリケーションの評価において、別のLLMに採点させる「LLM-as-a-Judge」は近年急速に普及している。だが本記事は、その自動評価器を構築する前に、開発者自身がログを地道に読むべきだと主張する。

背景にあるのは、評価器の品質はそれを定義する人間の理解度に依存するという事実だ。実際のユーザー入力や応答を読まずに「正確性」「丁寧さ」などの抽象的なルーブリックを設計しても、現場で起きる典型的な失敗パターンを捉えられない。記事では、まず数十〜数百件のログをサンプリングし、エラーを分類してタクソノミーを作る作業を推奨していると見られる。このプロセスを経て初めて、LLM-as-a-Judge のプロンプトに具体的で意味のある評価軸を組み込める。

この考え方は Hamel Husain や Shreya Shankar らが提唱する「Evals 駆動開発」と整合的である。彼らは、評価指標は最初から完成形で与えられるものではなく、ドメイン固有の失敗を観察しながら反復的に磨かれるものと位置づけている。LangSmith、Braintrust、Arize Phoenix といった LLMOps ツールがログ閲覧やアノテーション機能を強化しているのも、この潮流を反映していると言える。

また、人間とジャッジLLMの一致率(agreement rate)を測ることも重要視されつつある。ジャッジが人間判断と乖離していれば、いくら自動化しても無意味だからだ。逆に、人がログを読み込むことでプロンプトやリトリーバル設計そのものの欠陥に気づくケースも多く、評価器構築以前にプロダクト改善の機会を得られる可能性がある。

結論として、LLM-as-a-Judge は強力だが万能ではなく、人手によるログ精読という地道な工程を省くべきではない、という実務的な提言である。
entries.bodyEn:
Automated evaluation using LLM-as-a-Judge has become a popular pattern in LLM application development, but this article makes a counterintuitive case: before you build any automated judge, you should sit down and manually read your production logs.

The core argument is that evaluator quality is bounded by the evaluator designer's understanding of the system. If you write a rubric for accuracy, helpfulness, or politeness without first observing how your application actually fails in the wild, the resulting judge will measure abstractions that have little to do with the real failure modes your users encounter. The recommended workflow appears to be sampling tens to hundreds of real interactions, categorizing the errors you find, and building a failure taxonomy that can later inform a meaningful judge prompt.

This perspective aligns with what practitioners like Hamel Husain and Shreya Shankar have been advocating under the banner of evals-driven development. They argue that evaluation criteria are not given upfront but discovered iteratively by inspecting domain-specific failures. The growing emphasis on log viewing, trace inspection, and human annotation features in LLMOps platforms such as LangSmith, Braintrust, and Arize Phoenix reflects the same trend.

Another related practice gaining traction is measuring the agreement rate between human judges and the LLM judge. If your automated judge diverges significantly from human assessment, scaling it up only scales up noise. Conversely, the act of reading logs often surfaces problems that have nothing to do with evaluation at all — flawed prompts, retrieval gaps, or unexpected user intents — meaning the exercise can yield product improvements before any judge is built.

The broader takeaway is pragmatic rather than ideological. LLM-as-a-Judge remains a useful tool, but it is not a shortcut around the unglamorous work of looking at your data. Skipping the human-in-the-loop log reading phase tends to produce judges that feel rigorous but quietly mislead the team. The article can be read as a reminder that in LLM evaluation, as in classical ML, there is no substitute for actually understanding what your system does.

entries.title: Google's Gemma 4 AI models get 3x speed boost by predicting future tokens
entries.titleJa: Google Gemma 3 270M、投機的デコードで最大3倍高速化
entries.titleEn: Google's Gemma 4 AI models get 3x speed boost by predicting future tokens
entries.summaryJa: GoogleはGemmaシリーズに投機的デコード技術を導入し、推論速度を最大3倍に向上させた。小型モデルが将来のトークンを予測し、大型モデルが検証する方式で、品質を維持しつつ応答時間を短縮する。
entries.summaryEn: Google has applied speculative decoding to its Gemma open AI models, achieving up to 3x inference speedups by having a small draft model predict future tokens that a larger model verifies, preserving output quality.

image.alt: Google's Gemma 4 AI models get 3x speed boost by predicting future tokens

entries.bodyJa:
Googleがオープンモデル「Gemma」に投機的デコード(speculative decoding)を導入し、推論速度を最大3倍まで高速化したと報じられた。生成AIの応答遅延はユーザー体験とコストに直結するため、品質を犠牲にせず速度を稼ぐ手法として注目される。

投機的デコードは、軽量な「ドラフトモデル」が複数の将来トークンを先読みで生成し、本体の大型モデルが一括で検証・採用する仕組みだ。トークンを1つずつ生成する逐次処理に比べ、GPU/TPUの並列演算を有効活用できる点が肝となる。検証時に予測が一致しない場合は破棄されるため、最終出力は本体モデル単独で生成した場合と数学的に等価とされる。

この手法自体はDeepMindが2023年に論文として発表した古典的アプローチだが、Googleはこれをオープンモデルに統合する形で実装した。Gemmaは同社が公開する軽量オープンモデル群で、Llama(Meta)やMistral、Qwen(Alibaba)などと競合する位置づけにある。今回の最適化により、ローカル環境やエッジデバイスでの実行性能でも優位を確保したい狙いがあると見られる。

投機的デコードはvLLMやllama.cpp、TensorRT-LLMといった主要推論エンジンでも実装が進んでおり、業界標準となりつつある。OpenAIやAnthropicも内部で類似手法を活用しているとされ、推論コスト削減競争が本格化している。Googleが今回ドラフトモデルや実装の詳細を公開すれば、オープンソースコミュニティ全体のレイテンシ改善にも波及する可能性がある。
entries.bodyEn:
Google has reportedly applied speculative decoding to its Gemma family of open-weight AI models, claiming inference speedups of up to 3x without compromising output quality. As latency directly affects both user experience and serving costs, techniques that accelerate generation without sacrificing fidelity have become a key competitive battleground in the LLM industry.

Speculative decoding works by pairing a large target model with a much smaller, faster draft model. The draft model proposes several future tokens in a single forward pass, and the larger model then verifies them in parallel, accepting those that match what it would have generated and rejecting the rest. Because the verification step uses the full target model's distribution, the final output is mathematically equivalent to standard autoregressive decoding — the speedup comes purely from better utilization of GPU and TPU parallelism, which is typically underused during single-token generation.

The underlying technique is not new. DeepMind published a foundational paper on speculative sampling in 2023, and similar ideas have since been adopted across the ecosystem. What is notable here is Google's decision to bake the optimization directly into the Gemma release, lowering the barrier for developers running the models locally or on modest hardware. Gemma competes with Meta's Llama, Mistral's open releases, and Alibaba's Qwen series, where on-device performance and inference efficiency are increasingly important differentiators.

Speculative decoding has already been integrated into popular inference stacks such as vLLM, llama.cpp, and NVIDIA's TensorRT-LLM, and frontier providers like OpenAI and Anthropic are widely believed to use related techniques internally to reduce serving costs. By shipping draft models and tooling alongside Gemma, Google could meaningfully push the open-source community's latency floor lower, though the real-world speedup will depend on workload, batch size, and how well the draft model's predictions align with the target on a given task.

entries.title: National Nurses Week: Honoring the humanity at the heart of care
entries.titleJa: 全米看護師週間: ケアの中心にある人間性を称えるMicrosoftの取り組み
entries.titleEn: National Nurses Week: Honoring the humanity at the heart of care
entries.summaryJa: Microsoftは全米看護師週間に合わせ、看護師の声を反映した医療AIツールの開発姿勢を強調した。Dragon Copilotなどの臨床支援技術を通じ、記録業務の負担軽減と患者ケアへの集中を支援する取り組みを紹介している。
entries.summaryEn: For National Nurses Week, Microsoft highlights how its healthcare AI tools, including Dragon Copilot, are co-designed with nurses to reduce documentation burden and let clinicians focus on patient care.

image.alt: National Nurses Week: Honoring the humanity at the heart of care

entries.bodyJa:
Microsoftは全米看護師週間に合わせ、医療現場で働く看護師への敬意を表すとともに、同社の医療AIや臨床支援ツールが看護師との対話を通じて設計されていることを強調するブログを公開した。テクノロジー企業が看護師を単なるユーザーではなくデザインパートナーとして位置付ける姿勢は、近年の医療DXにおける重要なトレンドの一つと言える。

記事では、Microsoftが提供するDragon Copilotをはじめとする臨床ドキュメント支援ツールが、看護師の記録業務にかかる時間を削減し、患者と向き合う時間を確保することを目的としている点が紹介されている。米国では看護師の燃え尽き症候群が深刻化しており、電子カルテ(EHR)入力に費やす時間の長さがその一因として指摘されてきた。AIによる音声認識と要約技術は、こうした事務負担を軽減する有力な手段と見られている。

背景として、Microsoftは2024年にNuance Communicationsを通じて獲得したDAX(Dragon Ambient eXperience)技術を統合し、Dragon Copilotとして再ブランド展開している。競合のEpicやOracle Health(旧Cerner)もEHRへのAI統合を進めており、Google CloudのMedLM、AWSのHealthScribeなど各クラウドベンダーも同領域に参入している。看護師向けの音声記録支援はこれまで医師中心だった分野だが、対象拡大の動きが加速する可能性がある。

一方で、医療AI導入には正確性、プライバシー、規制対応など慎重な検討が必要だ。Microsoftが「信頼によって形作られた(shaped by trust)」と表現する背景には、現場の専門家と協働しながら段階的に展開する姿勢を示す意図があると見られる。
entries.bodyEn:
To mark National Nurses Week, Microsoft published a tribute blog underscoring how its healthcare AI and clinical tools are co-designed with nurses rather than simply deployed to them. The framing reflects a broader industry shift in which nursing input is treated as central to product design, not an afterthought.

The post highlights tools such as Dragon Copilot, Microsoft's AI-powered ambient clinical documentation assistant, as examples of technology built to ease the administrative load that has long weighed on nursing staff. In the United States, nurse burnout has become a defining workforce challenge, with documentation time inside electronic health records (EHRs) frequently cited as a leading driver. Microsoft argues that ambient listening, automated note generation, and contextual summarization can give nurses back time for direct patient care.

Dragon Copilot itself is the product of Microsoft's 2021 acquisition of Nuance Communications and the subsequent integration of the Dragon Ambient eXperience (DAX) platform. The rebrand under the Copilot umbrella signals Microsoft's intent to position clinical AI alongside its broader productivity portfolio. Competitors are moving in the same direction: Epic and Oracle Health (formerly Cerner) are embedding generative AI into their EHR workflows, while Google Cloud's MedLM and AWS HealthScribe target similar ambient documentation use cases. Historically these tools have focused on physicians, but expansion into nursing workflows appears to be accelerating.

Microsoft's emphasis on trust — phrases like "built with nurses, shaped by trust" — also reflects the regulatory and ethical sensitivity of healthcare AI. Tools that touch clinical documentation must navigate HIPAA, hallucination risk, bias, and integration with legacy EHR systems. The company appears to be signaling a measured, partnership-driven rollout rather than a top-down deployment, likely to reassure clinicians and health-system buyers wary of AI overreach.

Beyond product marketing, the broader takeaway is that nursing — the largest segment of the healthcare workforce — is increasingly seen as a strategic design partner for AI vendors. Whether Microsoft's collaborative framing translates into measurable reductions in burnout and improvements in patient outcomes will depend on real-world deployment data, which the industry is only beginning to gather at scale.

entries.title: Live updates from Elon Musk and Sam Altman’s court battle over the future of OpenAI
entries.titleJa: Musk対Altman、OpenAIの未来巡る法廷闘争始まる
entries.titleEn: Live updates from Elon Musk and Sam Altman’s court battle over the future of OpenAI
entries.summaryJa: Elon MuskとSam Altmanの対立がついに法廷へ。OpenAIの非営利から営利への転換を巡る訴訟が始まり、両者の確執やAI業界の方向性に大きな影響を与える可能性がある。本記事は審理の最新動向を追う。
entries.summaryEn: Elon Musk's lawsuit against Sam Altman and OpenAI heads to court, challenging the company's shift from nonprofit to for-profit structure in a case that could reshape the AI industry's future.

image.alt: Live updates from Elon Musk and Sam Altman’s court battle over the future of OpenAI

entries.bodyJa:
Elon MuskとSam Altmanという、AI業界を象徴する二人の対立がついに法廷の場へと持ち込まれた。OpenAIの設立理念からの逸脱を巡るこの訴訟は、単なる個人的確執を超え、AI開発のあり方そのものを問う重要な裁判となっている。

Muskは2015年にOpenAIの共同創設者の一人として参画し、初期の資金提供者でもあった。しかし2018年に取締役を退任した後、同社が当初の非営利の使命から離れ、Microsoftとの巨額提携を通じて事実上の営利企業へと変貌したと主張している。Muskの訴訟は、Altmanおよび現経営陣がOpenAI設立時の契約や信託義務に違反したと訴えており、OpenAIの組織再編計画そのものに法的な不確実性を投げかけている。

背景には、OpenAIが進めようとしている公益法人(PBC)への完全移行計画がある。同社はChatGPTの爆発的成功を受け、巨額の計算資源とインフラ投資を必要としており、従来の非営利・営利ハイブリッド構造では資本調達に限界があると見られる。一方Musk自身もxAIを設立し、Grokを展開するなど、OpenAIの直接的な競合となっている点も注目される。

この裁判はAnthropic、Google DeepMind、Metaなど他のAI主要プレイヤーにとっても示唆に富む。AI企業のガバナンス構造、創設時の理念と商業的現実との折り合い、そして「人類の利益のため」という曖昧な使命をどう法的に担保するかという問題は、業界全体が直面する課題となっている。判決次第では、OpenAIの再編計画が遅延・修正を余儀なくされる可能性もある。
entries.bodyEn:
The long-simmering feud between Elon Musk and Sam Altman has finally reached the courtroom, with a trial that could reshape not only OpenAI's future but the broader question of how AI companies balance mission and money. The Verge is providing live coverage as the proceedings unfold.

Musk was one of OpenAI's original co-founders and early funders when the lab launched in 2015 as a nonprofit dedicated to building artificial general intelligence for the benefit of humanity. He departed the board in 2018, and has since argued that Altman and the current leadership betrayed those founding principles by pivoting to a capped-profit structure, striking a multibillion-dollar partnership with Microsoft, and now seeking to convert the entity into a more conventional for-profit public benefit corporation.

The lawsuit alleges breach of contract and fiduciary duty, and seeks to block or unwind aspects of OpenAI's restructuring. OpenAI, for its part, has countered that Musk's grievances are largely sour grapes from a former insider who tried and failed to take control of the organization years ago, and who now competes directly through his own AI venture, xAI, and its Grok chatbot.

The stakes extend well beyond the two principals. OpenAI's planned conversion to a PBC is widely seen as a prerequisite for raising the staggering sums needed to fund frontier model training and data center buildouts — costs that have ballooned alongside ChatGPT's success. A ruling that constrains the restructuring could complicate fundraising, delay product roadmaps, and embolden regulators in the US and EU who are already scrutinizing AI governance.

The case also lands amid a broader industry reckoning over how labs founded with idealistic missions handle commercial pressure.
